_comment: Held-out agent test set for criterion G2. Each case gives the raw user text, the input STYLE (equation | word | conceptual), the area it should map to (for in-scope), and whether it is part of the PROTECTED CORE (which must succeed 100%). 'expect' is 'solve' (the agent must interpret it, call a tool, and return a verified scene) or 'decline' (out of scope — must be honestly declined, never answered with a fabricated result). tools/check_agent_coverage.py runs the agent (offline brain, no network) over this set and requires >=90% overall success and 100% of the protected core. Additions to this set are free (they broaden coverage); the protected core is the bar that may not be quietly lowered.
